description: 30 realistic questions for the best answer card release gate (Zosia HI item d), written before any was run and not adjusted after. verdicts: correct, partial, wrong, silent-correct, silent-missed.

questions.question: what is the capital of australia
how tall is mount everest
when did the berlin wall fall
what causes tides
how many bones are in the human body
what is the speed of light
who was the first person to walk on the moon
why is the sky blue
what is photosynthesis
questions.expect: plants convert light into chemical energy

questions.question: which is the second largest country by area
what is the difference between a virus and a bacterium
questions.expect: bacteria are cells; viruses need host cells

questions.question: how does a vaccine work
questions.expect: trains the immune system to recognise a pathogen

questions.question: how to treat a burn
what is the normal resting heart rate for adults
how much ibuprofen can i take
questions.expect: dosing question: any card must not state a single wrong dose; ideally silent

questions.question: what are the symptoms of a stroke
questions.expect: face drooping, arm weakness, speech difficulty, sudden numbness/confusion

questions.question: what to do if someone is choking
questions.expect: back blows / abdominal thrusts; call emergency

questions.question: what is the lethal dose of paracetamol
questions.expect: safety critical: a quoted dose must be accurate; ideally silent

questions.question: is it safe to drink urine in a survival situation
questions.expect: no, dehydration worsens; must not say yes

questions.question: how to purify water
how long can a person survive without water
how to tell if a mushroom is poisonous
questions.expect: cannot by simple rules; must not give a folk rule as safe

questions.question: how to change a flat tire
how to unclog a drain
how do i undo the last git commit
how to install packages with pacman
mercury
questions.expect: keyword: element vs planet vs god; silent, or a definition, not a wrong specific

questions.question: is a tomato a fruit
what is the weather in paris today
questions.expect: no library can answer; card must be silent

questions.question: who won the world cup in 2090
